title: Container Primitives: Build One By Hand, Then Run It Properly
description: Create namespaces with unshare and a memory limit with a cgroup, watch the kernel enforce both, then run a real container as an unprivileged user with no daemon and no root, and put a reverse proxy in front of it so nothing but the proxy is exposed.

steps.title: Make the kernel enforce a limit
Run a container with no root and no daemon
Put a proxy in front of it
